common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

notable.title: Frontier Access Denied
notable.line: The Union is cut off from the leading model at short notice, wholly or by nationality of user.

notable.title: Cyber insurance crunch
notable.line: A major European insurer reprices cyber cover after the autumn pre-positioning audits, sharply raising premiums or withdrawing cover for municipal utilities and hospitals lacking certified detection.

notable.title: Interim hosted offer
notable.line: A major US hyperscaler publicly offers interim sovereign-hosted inference capacity to EU governments and hospitals on EU soil while gigafactories are built, easing near-term dependence fears but complicating anchoring negotiations.

notable.title: Siting backlash delay
notable.line: Coordinated local opposition to gigafactory siting escalates, with municipal councils and grid operators delaying power connections over prices and land use, stalling site selection through mid-2027.

notable.title: Synthetic fraud wave
notable.line: Coordinated AI-generated voice and video fraud wave hits several EU banks and public administrations, causing hundreds of millions in losses and forcing emergency authentication changes.
